title: I made a Wave Race 64 style jetski racer that runs in the browser, built with AI
author: john1587
selftext:
Wave Blast is a blocky arcade jetski racer made with Three.js, built over a few weeks working with Claude.



\- 6 tracks, from a tropical bay to an erupting volcano with geysers and lava waves

\- Championship cups, time trials and a stunt mode with tricks

\- Items, drifting and mini-turbos, Mario Kart style

\- Plays on desktop and mobile, no download



I designed the game, tracks and feel, and handled music, sounds and voices. Claude helped with most of the code.



Play it here: [https://playgama.ai/play/uippcavkwj63yw](https://playgama.ai/play/uippcavkwj63yw)



Happy to answer questions about the workflow, and feedback is welcome!
